title: React Hooks
description: Review useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, and the Rules of Hooks.

questions.questionText: Which Hook adds local state to a function component?
questions.solution: useState returns a state value and a function that schedules updates to it.

questions.questionText: When does an effect with an empty dependency array normally run?
questions.solution: An empty dependency array makes the effect run after the initial mount, with cleanup on unmount.

questions.questionText: What can useRef preserve without causing a render when changed?
questions.optionA: A mutable value in its current property
questions.solution: A ref object persists across renders, and changing current does not trigger a render.

questions.questionText: What is useMemo intended to cache?
questions.solution: useMemo can reuse a calculated value while its listed dependencies remain unchanged.

questions.questionText: Where should Hooks be called according to the Rules of Hooks?
questions.optionB: At the top level of React functions or custom Hooks
questions.solution: Calling Hooks at the top level preserves a consistent call order across renders.
